name: Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart
summary: Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart is the grisly trophy taken from the felguard presiding over the depths of Ragefire Chasm. Neeru Fireblade requests this foul organ to appease Warchief Thrall, as proof that the demonic presence beneath Orgrimmar has been purged.

sections.title: A Trophy of Deceit
sections.body: Carved from the chest of Taragaman the Hungerer, this steaming demonic heart serves as physical proof of the brute's demise. Neeru Fireblade claims to Thrall and eager adventurers alike that Taragaman is the mastermind behind the Searing Blade cultists lurking in Ragefire Chasm. Presenting the heart to Neeru ostensibly satisfies the Warchief's mandate to safeguard Orgrimmar from demonic corruption, though presenting a brutish felguard as the cult's true architect conveniently conceals the deeper mortal networks operating beneath the city.

faq.q: Who wants Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade, an orc warlock residing in the Cleft of Shadows within Orgrimmar, asks adventurers to bring him the heart as proof that the demon has been slain.

faq.q: Where do I obtain this heart?
faq.answer: The heart is looted directly from the corpse of Taragaman the Hungerer, an imposing felguard located in the central magma chambers of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Does Thrall ever see the heart?
faq.answer: No. You deliver the heart directly to Neeru Fireblade, who claims he will properly handle the demonic remains and inform Warchief Thrall of the victory on your behalf.

faq.q: Was Taragaman truly the leader of the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade names the felguard as the Searing Blade's leader and insists that slaying him and bringing back his heart will appease Thrall.

angles.text: Cleansing the tunnels beneath Orgrimmar protects the young capital from being corrupted from within, making the beast's severed heart a symbol of the Horde's vigilance.
Dealing with Neeru Fireblade and handling harvested demonic remnants is familiar territory for warlocks, who understand the delicate web of shadow and deception playing out in the Cleft of Shadows.
